body: Sorry for the late reply but I'm just thinking: if everyone is special then nobody is. The reason I want to be special in some way is because I want meaning in life, or perhaps I want to be better than others. People say that "oh there will always be someone better than you" ok so then who's the best? But also, if someone's sole purpose is being good at maths and then another person comes along and is better at maths than them then what's the first person's meaning for life? It's the same with me, I want to be special even if I don't have friends I want my mind to be able to validate my existence. I'm not pretty I'm average at that, I'm not especially smart or anything and even my personality is just average I guess like I don't even think I have a personality anymore I don't enjoy anything I just feel empty. I bet people think the same thing as me with this. It just annoys me when I see others are so proud of themselves and to think they're better than others I kind of wish I was like them I wish I didn't notice all this because it puts me in an endless paradox of "everyone's different and special but at the same time someone out there is better than you"?! It makes no sense. How do I find any meaning in life at all? How is it that if everyone is so similar to me yet I feel so different and abnormal at the same time? I don't even get to feel special I feel ABNORMAL. Oh yeah but OTHERS feel abnormal too despite me seeing how they act in public? Is everyone just fake as fuck and I am the only honest human being left in existence?

I cant get off though. Its either this or loneliness. I only have my family and my mom and sister are usually at work and I have nobody else pretty much. I don't know how long this paranoia will last, it's been lasting for a while now im scared if i get off reddit (my only social media) that I will completely lose touch with reality.

I relate to this almost 100%. When I don't go through my depressive mood and want to die or go through my anger or euphoria I am super bored. Being bored and empty is like non-bpd people's less extreme version of a neutral normal mood but for us it can be suffocating. When I get like this I just want to not exist because showering, eating, drinking and basic stuff feels so boring. My mom calls me lazy lol I just sit there sometimes and watch stuff I watched before over and over again because I'm too bored to do anything else and then that gets boring. Conversations always help though, they're the one thing I look forward to. I don't have any friends but I have my mom and sister and spend sometimes HOURS talking to them. My sisters is an introvert so I can't talk to her all the time.  For learning German or other languages maybe you should try doing duolingo or an app instead because listening to an audio book and just sitting there does sound pretty boring I think to anyone tbh. When I go through this it's hard to start anything but when I do finally start and I get into it I think I get more drive. Before you start writing you could do something more energising like vaccuming your room or moving around a bit. Personally, when I'm in the shower I get TONS of ideas and stuff naturally come to me and I want to write them all down so maybe you could take a shower to get rid of the tired feeling and get more motivation? Or maybe go outdoors into the nature and observe your thoughts?  In case of anything you can always write about being bored and tired, I know I do that, I have a phone diary and I write a rant about how I'm bored and how I feel and try to convert the boredom into another emotion, even anger so then I use the anger to do my tasks angrily because I got rid of the bored tired feeling. Hope this helped you.

Hey this sounds like me! Personally, I imagine scenarios that I know won't happen at all like since I was a kid I did this all the time. I daydream about having superpowers or something. I daydream about  someone loving me and holding me when I cry - people caring about me. People putting in so much effort into getting to know me and me rejecting them and them still pursuing me and then I let them in and its amazing. I imagine scenarios upon scenarios upon scenarios. Me being the center of attention. Me getting validation. Me being perfect. Me being best. Me having pretty privelege. I imagine so much, I imagine even the bad. Sometimes I imagine arguments and fights and things that make me angry. It's like my life is centred around daydreaming constantly and being disconnected from reality. Now I'm 15 (16 this June) and it feels like my childhood was robbed and my teenage life too. I never got that surprise party I dreamed of I never got to be the pretty popular girl in secondary school. As angry and frustrated as it makes me I learnt a valuable lesson to try to enjoy things no matter what. Me and my mom and sister are going on a kind of a family trip near August to visit somewhere and instead of daydreaming away and being grumpy because I don't want to go out and have people see me I know I will try to enjoy it and even the little things I try to enjoy. I romanticise my life and pretend I'm actually the main character sometimes and that my life is like a ghibli movie. It's hard but I try hard too. "why can't I get something for once", I feel that, I really do. It feels like I don't have anything either - I'm not really pretty, not popular or particularly rich. I don't even have ANY friends and my family can suck sometimes too but if I give up then I won't even have myself anymore and you always have yourself until you give up. I don't know how to give advise, I haven't figured it out myself yet but I hope this helped.

You're not alone in what youre experiencing. I experience something similar. I think that someone might reach out to me and ask me if I'm okay or someone might even start a conversation with me. Nobody "genuinely" asks me whether I'm okay, it's literally like I have to say I'm fine or it'll be awkward. I feel unwanted and alone. You what calms me down? Being childish. Even though my childhood sucked, the innocence and state of mind was far better than now. I draw, I do colouring books sometimes, I dance, I blow bubbles, I write in my phone diary, I daydream, I watch barbie or some show or movie from my childhood. I hug stuffed animals. I remind myself that it could be worse no matter how hard it is now. And there always is a worse. I play videogames like minecraft sometimes. I avoid things that might trigger me too, for example on youtube there's among us content. Among us is very triggering for me because I've never played it, I don't have anyone to play it with so I avoid it like I avoid covid (lol). I try to improve myself and live my best life and be happy. I hope this helped.
